verdict.rationale: Algolia ships all three surfaces named in the story: a REST Search API for indexing/managing/querying (algolia-docs-4, algolia-docs-31), an official CLI for managing indices/settings/rules (algolia-docs-2, algolia-docs-50) verified runnable keylessly (algolia-probe-rt-1), and an official MCP server/skill for search, analytics, and index config (algolia-docs-17, algolia-docs-25, algolia-docs-50) confirmed live via OAuth-protected endpoint (algolia-probe-rt-2). This lets an agent create/query indices without a dashboard. Missing for 10: an explicit documented CLI/MCP command for adding/uploading documents (only 'manage indices, settings, rules, synonyms' is called out) and a single end-to-end walkthrough combining create-index+add-docs+query in one non-dashboard flow.
